nodes.text: Is it true that for every $\epsilon,\eta>0$ there exists a $k$ such that the density of $n$ for which\[P(n(n+1)\cdots(n+k))>n^{1-\epsilon}\]is at least $1-\eta$ (where $P(m)$ is the greatest prime divisor of $m$)?

#1201 : [Er80,p.107] number theory | primes Erdős wrote he could prove this for $\epsilon=1/2$.
